name: strel
comment: Sig: se = strel(shape, params). Returns struct (numkit) / strel-object (MATLAB) with fields {Neighborhood, Dimensionality}. Structure access matches; the 'square' shape is bit-identical (both engines: 5x5 = 25 ones). NOTE: 'disk' decomposes into smaller equivalent in MATLAB R2025b (line-strel cascade) -- numkit returns the full disk mask. Both yield identical morphology results, just different .Neighborhood matrices. Field access works in both.
